services.desc: Tipsy Pickle is a 23,000 sq ft entertainment destination in Charlotte, NC. We host a variety of events each year, from corporate gatherings, wedding parties, birthday bashes (yes, even kid ones), we make it easy and fun to celebrate. The mezzanine is a secluded event space with a full bar, two trackman golf simulators, and plenty of seating. Looking over the entire space, the mezzanine is the perfect spot to eat, drink, play, and watch the games. Where the magic happens. The main floor is full of arcade games, pickleball courts, and our largest bar.
